rules.message: CBC mode detected in Go; ensure encryption is authenticated or use AEAD.
rules.remediation: Prefer cipher.AEAD (GCM) or apply Encrypt-then-MAC with HMAC-SHA256.

rules.message: MD5 detected in Go code; MD5 is deprecated for cryptographic uses.
rules.remediation: Use SHA-256 or stronger hash functions; for passwords, use Argon2/bcrypt/scrypt.

rules.message: RSA key generation with small key size detected.
rules.remediation: Use at least 2048-bit keys or migrate to modern primitives.

rules.message: Non-cryptographic RNG (math/rand) used in Go code.
rules.remediation: Use crypto/rand for generating keys, nonces, and secrets.

rules.message: AEAD mode (GCM) detected; best practice for authenticated encryption.
rules.remediation: Continue using GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 for authenticated encryption.

rules.message: DSA detected; prefer ECDSA or RSA for new systems.
rules.remediation: Migrate to ECDSA (P-256 or P-384) or RSA-2048+ for signatures.

rules.message: Legacy RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 encryption API detected.
rules.remediation: Prefer rsa.EncryptOAEP/rsa.DecryptOAEP for new encryption flows.
Increase to >=100k and reassess policy regularly; consider Argon2id where suitable.

rules.message: Classical public-key cryptography detected; prepare post-quantum migration plan.
rules.remediation: Use hybrid migration strategy with ML-KEM/ML-DSA plus classical algorithms during transition.
